description: This file defines the class ThreadCheckingRepaintManager, which extends RepaintManager to add thread checking and component tree dumping functionalities for Swing components.

classes.name: ThreadCheckingRepaintManager
classes.description: A custom RepaintManager that checks for thread violations and dumps component hierarchy when components are invalidated or marked dirty.

methods.name: ThreadCheckingRepaintManager
methods.description: Constructor that sets whether to check if components are showing.

methods.name: addInvalidComponent
methods.description: Overrides to check thread before adding invalid components.

methods.name: checkThread
methods.description: Checks if the current thread is the Event Dispatch Thread; if not, logs warning and dumps component tree.

methods.name: getStracktraceAsString
methods.description: Converts an exception's stack trace to a string.

methods.name: checkIsShowing
methods.description: Determines if component is showing based on configuration.

methods.name: addDirtyRegion
methods.description: Overrides to check thread before marking regions dirty.

methods.name: dumpComponentTree
methods.description: Prints the hierarchy of components starting from a given component.

methods.name: resetTabCount
methods.description: Resets indentation level for component tree printing.
